title: Develop an SEO optimization strategy and metadata plan for Nigerian edtech search terms
description:
Create an actionable SEO strategy and metadata optimization plan targeting Nigerian edtech queries around learning platforms and cohort management.

Include:
1. Keyword Map: 25 localized keywords (e.g., 'virtual classroom software Nigeria', 'school portal with live classes Lagos', 'cohort LMS Abuja') with intent classification and priority score.
2. Metadata Plan: Optimized title tags (under 60 characters) and meta descriptions (under 155 characters) for 5 core Zedu routes (/solutions/bootcamps, /pricing, /products/ai-agents, /products/live-classes, /products/assignments).
3. Localized Search Positioning: Content recommendations emphasizing flat Naira pricing, zero per-student fees, and lightweight data consumption for mobile learners.
4. Schema Markup Specs: JSON-LD guidelines for FAQPage and SoftwareApplication tags.

Deliver a clean markdown specification in the attachment with zero hallucinated claims.
rationale: Directly supports our Nigerian organic acquisition focus by capturing educators searching for local virtual learning and cohort software.
